# Community Rule Column 1 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 1

---

**1:1** [...the book of the rul]e of the community: to seek God wholeheartedly and with one's entire being,
**1:2** to do what is good and right in His sight, just as He commanded through Moses and through all His servants the prophets;
**1:3** to love everything He has chosen and reject everything He has spurned; to stay far from all evil
**1:4** and hold fast to every good deed; to live out truth, righteousness, and justice
**1:5** in the land, and never again to follow a stubborn and guilty heart or wanton desires,
**1:6** committing every kind of evil. All who willingly devote themselves to keeping God's commands are to be brought
**1:7** into the covenant of lovingkindness, to be joined together in God's purpose and to live before Him with integrity,
**1:8** in keeping with everything revealed for the times He has appointed. They are to love all the Children of Light,
**1:9** each one in proportion to his standing in God's purpose, and to despise all the Children of Darkness,
**1:10** each one in proportion to his guilt when God brings justice.
**1:11** Everyone who volunteers for His truth must bring all of their understanding, all of their ability,
**1:12** and all of their possessions into God's community. Their understanding is to be refined through the truth of God's commands, their ability directed
**1:13** according to His perfect ways, and all their possessions governed by His just guidance. They must never violate
**1:14** any of God's instructions regarding the proper times; they must never celebrate early or observe late —
**1:15** not one of their appointed seasons. They must not deviate from His reliable commands in any direction.
**1:16** Everyone who enters the community's order must cross over into the covenant before God, committing
**1:17** to act on everything He has commanded, never turning back from following Him out of any fear, terror,
**1:18** or ordeal during the reign of Belial. As they cross into the covenant, the priests
**1:19** and the Levites will praise the God of deliverance and all His faithful works; and everyone
**1:20** crossing into the covenant will respond after them: "Amen, amen!"
**1:21** The priests will then recite God's righteous deeds and His displays of power,
**1:22** and they will proclaim all His faithful mercies toward Israel. The Levites will recite
**1:23** the wrongdoings of the Israelites — all their guilty rebellions and sins committed under the reign of
**1:24** Belial. Then everyone crossing into the covenant will confess after them, saying: "We have been corrupt,
**1:25** we have rebelled, we have sinned, we have been wicked — we and our ancestors before us — by living
**1:26** in defiance of the commands of truth. Yet God is just, and His verdict against us and our ancestors is deserved."

---
*PNEUMA notes: This translation prioritizes accessibility while preserving the ceremonial weight of the covenant-entry ritual. "Berith chesed" becomes "covenant of lovingkindness" to communicate the Hebrew concept. "Sons of Light/Darkness" rendered as "Children of Light/Darkness" for inclusive language. "Belial" retained as it functions as a proper name for the prince of evil. The confessional litany in 1:24-26 uses contemporary penitential phrasing while maintaining the cumulative rhetorical force of the Hebrew synonyms.*
